name: @polaris/cre-workflows
description: Polaris's Chainlink CRE workflows: collections (cron) and underwriting (HTTP), the orchestration layer of the Pay in 4 credit engine on Monad.

scripts.build: node scripts/cre.mjs workflow build ./collections && node scripts/cre.mjs workflow build ./underwriting
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/cre.mjs --deps && tsc -p collections/tsconfig.json && tsc -p underwriting/tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.simulate:underwriting: node --experimental-strip-types --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning --conditions=source scripts/underwriting-payload.mjs && node scripts/cre.mjs workflow simulate ./underwriting --non-interactive --trigger-index 0 --http-payload ./underwriting/payload.json --broadcast -T
